notes.title: Update #2 - Boss reveal!
notes.notes:
Hello hello!


It’s been a while since the last update, and we’ve been hard at work! 🏗️

Last time we shared an artwork of our first boss and now - lo and behold - here it is in all its glory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526788/cec8e9c87e917ebdbf82a80e795b6b03b08ff00b.gif[/img]
They grow up so fast... 😭

This beauty, called [b]Smelter Saw[/b], is a demolition expert that combines short-range melee attacks with its claws, together with homing missiles and heat-based attacks to achieve total destruction.


Was this the only thing we were working on? Oh, hell, no! 😂

Please take a look at the first iteration of the [b]Motherboard[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526788/06fe4c5e17be0b992d5a71a91263da6236be0959.png[/img]
The Motherboard is our character creator system, stats system, and weapon customization system all in one. Placing different types of mods on your motherboard, you modify weapons, skills, visual aspects, and performances of your robot. Cool, right? Can’t wait to show this little gem in more depth!


[h3]How to stay in the loop?[/h3]
There’s no Discord or anything yet, we’ll set it up with the first playable demo, or sooner if it makes sense. If you want to keep up with our progress for now… Wishlist and Follow on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526788/f602950a1d739f3d507937fe52d82135853ca53a.gif[/img]

Cheers,
Armored Souls Team

notes.title: Update #1 - Welcome to Armored Souls!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome!


We just published our Steam page and we wanted to give you some more info about what to expect from Armored Souls.

We take inspiration from Soulslike games (including ofc Armored Core) and Roguelike games, and we are working hard to make a kickass game centered around building (literally) your character and clashing with mean bosses.

Imagine Dark Souls’ variety of weapons and movesets combined with Nier Automata Plug-In Chips to make an incredibly flexible build system where you program your own attacks, decide what each of your controller buttons do, and stack effects upon effects to create devastating attacks… or use auto-fire mods that will take care of enemies while you run for your life!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526788/116443a7fe99c9085cb97133b804a1816058bf76.png[/img]
This is boss #1. He is very mean.


[h3]How to stay in the loop?[/h3]
There’s no Discord or anything yet, we’ll set it up with the first playable demo, or sooner if it makes sense. If you want to keep up with our progress for now… Wishlist and Follow on Steam!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44526788/c4fe6c26927a24406d306aacb32c917b0c47da4a.gif[/img]

Cheers,
Armored Souls Team
